                                if(nonConsentedCookie.Name.trim().length > 2){
                                    var nonConsentedCookiePatterns = ['_ga'];
                                    var nonConsentedCookieInitialChars = nonConsentedCookie.Name.trim().substring(0, 3);
                                    if(nonConsentedCookiePatterns.includes(nonConsentedCookieInitialChars.toLowerCase())){
                                        var systemCookies = document.cookie.split(";");
                                        systemCookies.forEach(function(systemCookie){
                                            systemCookie = systemCookie.split("=");
                                            if(systemCookie.length){
                                                var systemCookieName = systemCookie[0].trim();
                                                if(systemCookieName.indexOf(nonConsentedCookieInitialChars) === 0){
                                                    eraseCookie(systemCookieName, window.location.hostname);
                                                    eraseCookie(systemCookieName, nonConsentedCookie.Host);
                                                }
                                            }
                                        })
                                    }
                                }
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }

                function eraseCookie(name, domain) {
                    var domainLength = 2;
                    if(domain.includes("co.uk")){
                        domainLength = 3;
                    }
                    var domainWithoutWWW = domain.split("www.").join("");
                    var rootDomain = domain.split('.').slice(-domainLength).join('.');
                    document.cookie = name+'=;path=/;expires=' + new Date(0).toUTCString();
                    document.cookie = name+'=;path=/;expires=' + new Date(0).toUTCString()+';domain=' + domain;
                    document.cookie = name+'=;path=/;expires=' + new Date(0).toUTCString()+';domain=' + domainWithoutWWW;
                    document.cookie = name+'=;path=/;expires=' + new Date(0).toUTCString()+';domain=' + rootDomain;
                }
            }

            this._entries.sort(function(a, b) {
                return a[0].localeCompare(b[0]);
            });
        };

        SafeURLSearchParams.prototype.toString = function() {
            var parts = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < this._entries.length; i++) {
                parts.push(this._encode(this._entries[i][0]) + '=' + this._encode(this._entries[i][1]));
            }
            return parts.join('&');
        };

        SafeURLSearchParams.prototype.forEach = function(callback, thisArg) {
            for (var i = 0; i < this._entries.length; i++) {
                callback.call(thisArg, this._entries[i][1], this._entries[i][0], this);
            }
        };

        SafeURLSearchParams.prototype.toObject = function() {
            var result = {};
            for (var i = 0; i < this._entries.length; i++) {
                var key = this._entries[i][0];
                if (!(key in result)) {
                    result[key] = this._entries[i][1];
                }
            }
            return result;
        };

        SafeURLSearchParams.prototype.toObjectAll = function() {
            var result = {};
            for (var i = 0; i < this._entries.length; i++) {
                var key = this._entries[i][0];
                if (!(key in result)) {
                    result[key] = [];
                }
                result[key].push(this._entries[i][1]);
            }
            return result;

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
            if(window.userInteractionCaptured) return;
            var interactionEvents = ["touchstart", "touchmove", "scroll", "mousemove", "mousedown", "DOMMouseScroll", "mousewheel", "keyup"];
            window.userInteractionCaptured = false;
            function interactionHandler() {
                if (window.userInteractionCaptured) return;
                console.debug('User Interaction captured');
                window.userInteractionCaptured = true;
                interactionEvents.forEach(function(eventType) {
                    document.body.removeEventListener(eventType, interactionHandler);
                });
            }
            interactionEvents.forEach(function(eventType) {
                document.body.addEventListener(eventType, interactionHandler);

        function getMetaInfoFromPath(titleDescMap, value){
            try{
                var path = window.location.pathname;
                if (path.startsWith('/')) {
                    path = path.substring(1);
                }
                var languagePaths = ['fr-ca/', 'es/', 'ru/', 'pl/', 'ar/'];
                for (var langPath of languagePaths) {
                    if (path.toLowerCase().startsWith(langPath)) {
                        path = path.substring(langPath.length);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                var pathNames= [path.replace(/\//g, '-'), path.split("/")[0]];
                for(var pathName of pathNames){
                    var key = pathName+"."+value;
                    if(titleDescMap.hasOwnProperty(key)){
                        return titleDescMap[key];
                    }
                }
            }catch (e) {
                return '';
            }
        }

    <script>
        var isAnonymous = appInit.isAnonymous;
        function getCookieByName(cookieName) {
            var name = cookieName + "=";
            var cookieDecoded = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie);
            var cookieArr = cookieDecoded.split('; ');
            var res = null;
            cookieArr.forEach(function (val) {
                if (val.indexOf(name) === 0) res = val.substring(name.length);
            });
            return res;
        }

        function updateUserCategoryCookie(cookieValue) {
            // Expire the userCategory cookie in 50 years
            document.cookie = "userCategory=" + cookieValue + ";max-age="+ 60*60*24*365*50+"; path=/";
        }

        /*
        *  LIM: Logged-in Member
        *  LOM: Logged-out Member
        *  PU:  Public User
        *  RPU: Recurring Public User
        * */

        var userCategory = getCookieByName("userCategory");
        if(!userCategory){
            updateUserCategoryCookie("PU");
        }else if(isAnonymous){
            if(userCategory == "LIM"){
                updateUserCategoryCookie("LOM");
            }else if(userCategory != "LOM"){
                updateUserCategoryCookie("RPU");
            }
        }
    </script>

            function setCookie(name, value, days) {
                var expires = '';
                if (days) {
                    var date = new Date();
                    date.setTime(date.getTime() + (days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
                    expires = '; expires=' + date.toUTCString();

                document.cookie = name + '=' + (value || '') + expires + '; path=/';

                            localStorage.setItem('anonymousCrmId', crmId);
                        }catch (e) {

        <script type="text/javascript">
            function OptanonWrapper() {
                try{
                    console.log("Validating Cookie Policy: " + OnetrustActiveGroups)
                    if(typeof cookieConsent !== "undefined" && cookieConsent !== OnetrustActiveGroups){
                        console.log("Previous consent: " + cookieConsent);
                        console.log("Current consent: " + OnetrustActiveGroups);
                        console.log("Cookie consent changed, reloading to update cookies");
                        window.location.reload();
                    }else{
                        cookieConsent = OnetrustActiveGroups;
                        // Sending cookie consent on One Trust to GTM
                        if(typeof cookieConsent !== "undefined" && typeof googleTagManager !== "undefined") {
                            cookieConsent = cookieConsent.toString().toLowerCase();
                            googleTagManager.track({ 'event': 'OneTrustLoaded', 'OnetrustActiveGroups': cookieConsent });
                            var previousConsent = localStorage.getItem("cookieConsent");
                            if(!!previousConsent && cookieConsent !== previousConsent){
                                googleTagManager.track({ 'event': 'OneTrustGroupsUpdated', 'OnetrustActiveGroups': cookieConsent });
                            }
                            localStorage.setItem("cookieConsent", cookieConsent);
                        }
                        otDeleteCookie();
                    }
                }catch (e) {
                    console.log("Error deleting cookies", e);
                }

                function otDeleteCookie() {
                    var allGroups = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(Optanon.GetDomainData().Groups));
                    var consentedGroups = OnetrustActiveGroups.split(",").filter(Boolean);
                    var nonConsentedGroups = allGroups.filter(function(group) {
                        return !consentedGroups.includes(group.CustomGroupId)
                    });
                    nonConsentedGroups.forEach(function(nonConsentedGroup){
                        if(Array.isArray(nonConsentedGroup.Cookies)){
                            nonConsentedGroup.Cookies.forEach(function(nonConsentedCookie){
                                eraseCookie(nonConsentedCookie.Name, window.location.hostname);
                                eraseCookie(nonConsentedCookie.Name, nonConsentedCookie.Host);
                                if(nonConsentedCookie.Name.trim().length > 2){
                                    var nonConsentedCookiePatterns = ['_ga'];
                                    var nonConsentedCookieInitialChars = nonConsentedCookie.Name.trim().substring(0, 3);
                                    if(nonConsentedCookiePatterns.includes(nonConsentedCookieInitialChars.toLowerCase())){
                                        var systemCookies = document.cookie.split(";");
                                        systemCookies.forEach(function(systemCookie){
                                            systemCookie = systemCookie.split("=");
                                            if(systemCookie.length){
                                                var systemCookieName = systemCookie[0].trim();
                                                if(systemCookieName.indexOf(nonConsentedCookieInitialChars) === 0){
                                                    eraseCookie(systemCookieName, window.location.hostname);
                                                    eraseCookie(systemCookieName, nonConsentedCookie.Host);
                                                }
                                            }
                                        })
                                    }
                                }
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }

                function eraseCookie(name, domain) {
                    var domainLength = 2;
                    if(domain.includes("co.uk")){
                        domainLength = 3;
                    }
                    var domainWithoutWWW = domain.split("www.").join("");
                    var rootDomain = domain.split('.').slice(-domainLength).join('.');
                    document.cookie = name+'=;path=/;expires=' + new Date(0).toUTCString();
                    document.cookie = name+'=;path=/;expires=' + new Date(0).toUTCString()+';domain=' + domain;
                    document.cookie = name+'=;path=/;expires=' + new Date(0).toUTCString()+';domain=' + domainWithoutWWW;
                    document.cookie = name+'=;path=/;expires=' + new Date(0).toUTCString()+';domain=' + rootDomain;

            var oldOnLoad = window.onload;
            if (typeof window.onload != 'function') {
                window.onload = onLoad;
            }
            else {
                if(window.onLoadCalled){

        addLoadEvent(function (){

          var observer = new MutationObserver(function() {
            if (currentHref !== document.location.href) {
              currentHref = document.location.href;
              urlHistory.push(currentHref);
            }
          });

          observer.observe(document.querySelector("body"), {
            childList: true,
            subtree: true
          });
        });

            if(beforeLoad){

          return null;

                var key = this._entries[i][0];
                if (!(key in result)) {
                    result[key] = this._entries[i][1];
                }
            }
            return result;
        };

        SafeURLSearchParams.prototype.toObjectAll = function() {
            var result = {};
            for (var i = 0; i < this._entries.length; i++) {
                var key = this._entries[i][0];
                if (!(key in result)) {
                    result[key] = [];
                }
                result[key].push(this._entries[i][1]);
            }
            return result;
        };

        // Expose globally
        window.SafeURLSearchParams = SafeURLSearchParams;

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
            if(window.userInteractionCaptured) return;
            var interactionEvents = ["touchstart", "touchmove", "scroll", "mousemove", "mousedown", "DOMMouseScroll", "mousewheel", "keyup"];
            window.userInteractionCaptured = false;
            function interactionHandler() {
                if (window.userInteractionCaptured) return;
                console.debug('User Interaction captured');
                window.userInteractionCaptured = true;
                interactionEvents.forEach(function(eventType) {
                    document.body.removeEventListener(eventType, interactionHandler);
                });
            }
            interactionEvents.forEach(function(eventType) {
                document.body.addEventListener(eventType, interactionHandler);
            });
        })

        function getMetaInfoFromPath(titleDescMap, value){
            try{
                var path = window.location.pathname;
                if (path.startsWith('/')) {
                    path = path.substring(1);
                }
                var languagePaths = ['fr-ca/', 'es/', 'ru/', 'pl/', 'ar/'];
                for (var langPath of languagePaths) {
                    if (path.toLowerCase().startsWith(langPath)) {
                        path = path.substring(langPath.length);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                var pathNames= [path.replace(/\//g, '-'), path.split("/")[0]];
                for(var pathName of pathNames){
                    var key = pathName+"."+value;
                    if(titleDescMap.hasOwnProperty(key)){
                        return titleDescMap[key];
                    }
                }
            }catch (e) {
                return '';
            }
        }

    <script>
        var isAnonymous = appInit.isAnonymous;
        function getCookieByName(cookieName) {
            var name = cookieName + "=";
            var cookieDecoded = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie);
            var cookieArr = cookieDecoded.split('; ');
            var res = null;
            cookieArr.forEach(function (val) {
                if (val.indexOf(name) === 0) res = val.substring(name.length);
            });
            return res;
        }

        function updateUserCategoryCookie(cookieValue) {
            // Expire the userCategory cookie in 50 years
            document.cookie = "userCategory=" + cookieValue + ";max-age="+ 60*60*24*365*50+"; path=/";
        }

        /*
        *  LIM: Logged-in Member
        *  LOM: Logged-out Member
        *  PU:  Public User
        *  RPU: Recurring Public User
        * */

        var userCategory = getCookieByName("userCategory");
        if(!userCategory){
            updateUserCategoryCookie("PU");
        }else if(isAnonymous){
            if(userCategory == "LIM"){
                updateUserCategoryCookie("LOM");
            }else if(userCategory != "LOM"){
                updateUserCategoryCookie("RPU");
            }
        }

                        console.log("Previous consent: " + cookieConsent);

                        console.log("Cookie consent changed, reloading to update cookies");

                    }else{
                        cookieConsent = OnetrustActiveGroups;
                        // Sending cookie consent on One Trust to GTM
                        if(typeof cookieConsent !== "undefined" && typeof googleTagManager !== "undefined") {
                            cookieConsent = cookieConsent.toString().toLowerCase();
                            googleTagManager.track({ 'event': 'OneTrustLoaded', 'OnetrustActiveGroups': cookieConsent });
                            var previousConsent = localStorage.getItem("cookieConsent");
                            if(!!previousConsent && cookieConsent !== previousConsent){

                            }
                            localStorage.setItem("cookieConsent", cookieConsent);
                        }
                        otDeleteCookie();
                    }
                }catch (e) {
                    console.log("Error deleting cookies", e);
                }

                function otDeleteCookie() {
                    var allGroups = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(Optanon.GetDomainData().Groups));
                    var consentedGroups = OnetrustActiveGroups.split(",").filter(Boolean);
                    var nonConsentedGroups = allGroups.filter(function(group) {
                        return !consentedGroups.includes(group.CustomGroupId)
                    });
                    nonConsentedGroups.forEach(function(nonConsentedGroup){
                        if(Array.isArray(nonConsentedGroup.Cookies)){
                            nonConsentedGroup.Cookies.forEach(function(nonConsentedCookie){
                                eraseCookie(nonConsentedCookie.Name, window.location.hostname);
                                eraseCookie(nonConsentedCookie.Name, nonConsentedCookie.Host);
                                if(nonConsentedCookie.Name.trim().length > 2){
                                    var nonConsentedCookiePatterns = ['_ga'];
                                    var nonConsentedCookieInitialChars = nonConsentedCookie.Name.trim().substring(0, 3);
                                    if(nonConsentedCookiePatterns.includes(nonConsentedCookieInitialChars.toLowerCase())){
                                        var systemCookies = document.cookie.split(";");
                                        systemCookies.forEach(function(systemCookie){
                                            systemCookie = systemCookie.split("=");
                                            if(systemCookie.length){
                                                var systemCookieName = systemCookie[0].trim();
                                                if(systemCookieName.indexOf(nonConsentedCookieInitialChars) === 0){
                                                    eraseCookie(systemCookieName, window.location.hostname);
                                                    eraseCookie(systemCookieName, nonConsentedCookie.Host);
                                                }
                                            }
                                        })
                                    }
                                }
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }

                function eraseCookie(name, domain) {
                    var domainLength = 2;
                    if(domain.includes("co.uk")){
                        domainLength = 3;
                    }
                    var domainWithoutWWW = domain.split("www.").join("");
                    var rootDomain = domain.split('.').slice(-domainLength).join('.');
                    document.cookie = name+'=;path=/;expires=' + new Date(0).toUTCString();
                    document.cookie = name+'=;path=/;expires=' + new Date(0).toUTCString()+';domain=' + domain;
                    document.cookie = name+'=;path=/;expires=' + new Date(0).toUTCString()+';domain=' + domainWithoutWWW;
                    document.cookie = name+'=;path=/;expires=' + new Date(0).toUTCString()+';domain=' + rootDomain;
                }
            }

            var oldOnLoad = window.onload;
            if (typeof window.onload != 'function') {
                window.onload = onLoad;
            }
            else {
                if(window.onLoadCalled){

        addLoadEvent(function (){

          var observer = new MutationObserver(function() {
            if (currentHref !== document.location.href) {
              currentHref = document.location.href;
              urlHistory.push(currentHref);
            }
          });

          observer.observe(document.querySelector("body"), {
            childList: true,
            subtree: true
          });
        });

          return null;

            for (var i = 0; i < this._entries.length; i++) {
                var key = this._entries[i][0];
                if (!(key in result)) {
                    result[key] = this._entries[i][1];
                }
            }
            return result;
        };

        SafeURLSearchParams.prototype.toObjectAll = function() {
            var result = {};
            for (var i = 0; i < this._entries.length; i++) {
                var key = this._entries[i][0];
                if (!(key in result)) {
                    result[key] = [];
                }
                result[key].push(this._entries[i][1]);
            }
            return result;
        };

        // Expose globally
        window.SafeURLSearchParams = SafeURLSearchParams;

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
            if(window.userInteractionCaptured) return;
            var interactionEvents = ["touchstart", "touchmove", "scroll", "mousemove", "mousedown", "DOMMouseScroll", "mousewheel", "keyup"];
            window.userInteractionCaptured = false;
            function interactionHandler() {
                if (window.userInteractionCaptured) return;
                console.debug('User Interaction captured');
                window.userInteractionCaptured = true;
                interactionEvents.forEach(function(eventType) {
                    document.body.removeEventListener(eventType, interactionHandler);
                });
            }
            interactionEvents.forEach(function(eventType) {
                document.body.addEventListener(eventType, interactionHandler);
            });
        })

        function getMetaInfoFromPath(titleDescMap, value){
            try{
                var path = window.location.pathname;
                if (path.startsWith('/')) {
                    path = path.substring(1);
                }
                var languagePaths = ['fr-ca/', 'es/', 'ru/', 'pl/', 'ar/'];
                for (var langPath of languagePaths) {
                    if (path.toLowerCase().startsWith(langPath)) {
                        path = path.substring(langPath.length);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                var pathNames= [path.replace(/\//g, '-'), path.split("/")[0]];
                for(var pathName of pathNames){
                    var key = pathName+"."+value;
                    if(titleDescMap.hasOwnProperty(key)){
                        return titleDescMap[key];
                    }
                }
            }catch (e) {
                return '';
            }
        }

    <script>
        var isAnonymous = appInit.isAnonymous;
        function getCookieByName(cookieName) {
            var name = cookieName + "=";
            var cookieDecoded = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie);
            var cookieArr = cookieDecoded.split('; ');
            var res = null;
            cookieArr.forEach(function (val) {
                if (val.indexOf(name) === 0) res = val.substring(name.length);
            });
            return res;
        }

        function updateUserCategoryCookie(cookieValue) {
            // Expire the userCategory cookie in 50 years
            document.cookie = "userCategory=" + cookieValue + ";max-age="+ 60*60*24*365*50+"; path=/";
        }

        /*
        *  LIM: Logged-in Member
        *  LOM: Logged-out Member
        *  PU:  Public User
        *  RPU: Recurring Public User
        * */

        var userCategory = getCookieByName("userCategory");
        if(!userCategory){
            updateUserCategoryCookie("PU");
        }else if(isAnonymous){
            if(userCategory == "LIM"){
                updateUserCategoryCookie("LOM");
            }else if(userCategory != "LOM"){
                updateUserCategoryCookie("RPU");
            }
        }
    </script>

        function getMetaInfoFromPath(titleDescMap, value){

                if (path.startsWith('/')) {
                    path = path.substring(1);
                }
                var languagePaths = ['fr-ca/', 'es/', 'ru/', 'pl/', 'ar/'];
                for (var langPath of languagePaths) {
                    if (path.toLowerCase().startsWith(langPath)) {
                        path = path.substring(langPath.length);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                var pathNames= [path.replace(/\//g, '-'), path.split("/")[0]];
                for(var pathName of pathNames){

                    if(titleDescMap.hasOwnProperty(key)){

        var isAnonymous = appInit.isAnonymous;
        function getCookieByName(cookieName) {
            var name = cookieName + "=";
            var cookieDecoded = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie);
            var cookieArr = cookieDecoded.split('; ');
            var res = null;
            cookieArr.forEach(function (val) {
                if (val.indexOf(name) === 0) res = val.substring(name.length);
            });
            return res;
        }

        function updateUserCategoryCookie(cookieValue) {
            // Expire the userCategory cookie in 50 years
            document.cookie = "userCategory=" + cookieValue + ";max-age="+ 60*60*24*365*50+"; path=/";
        }

        /*
        *  LIM: Logged-in Member
        *  LOM: Logged-out Member
        *  PU:  Public User
        *  RPU: Recurring Public User
        * */

        var userCategory = getCookieByName("userCategory");
        if(!userCategory){
            updateUserCategoryCookie("PU");
        }else if(isAnonymous){
            if(userCategory == "LIM"){
                updateUserCategoryCookie("LOM");
            }else if(userCategory != "LOM"){
                updateUserCategoryCookie("RPU");
            }
        }
    </script>

        <script>
            function captureAndStoreParameters(params) {
                var previousConsent = localStorage.getItem("cookieConsent");
                var paramsToCapture = ['utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_term', 'utm_content', 'gclid', 'msclkid', 'fbclid', 'eid'];
                var utmParams = {};
                var utmParamsFound = false;
                paramsToCapture.forEach(function(param) {
                    if (params && params[param]) {
                        utmParamsFound = true;
                        if(previousConsent && previousConsent.includes(',c0002') && previousConsent.includes(',c0004')) {
                            setCookie("g2app." +param, params[param], 7);
                        }
                        utmParams[param] = params[param];
                    }
                });
                if(utmParamsFound){
                    sessionStorage.setItem("g2app.utmParams", JSON.stringify(utmParams));
                }
            }

            function setCookie(name, value, days) {
                var expires = '';
                if (days) {
                    var date = new Date();
                    date.setTime(date.getTime() + (days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
                    expires = '; expires=' + date.toUTCString();
                }
                document.cookie = name + '=' + (value || '') + expires + '; path=/';
            }
            function generateQueryId() {
                var crmId;
                if(appInit.isAnonymous){
                    var anonymousCrmId = appInit.anonymousCrmId;
                    var localStorageAnonymousCrmId = localStorage.getItem('anonymousCrmId');
                    var cookieAnonymousCrmId = getCookieByName("anonymousCrmId");
                    if(!!anonymousCrmId && anonymousCrmId !== 'null' && anonymousCrmId !== 'undefined'){
                        crmId = anonymousCrmId;
                    } else if(!!localStorageAnonymousCrmId && localStorageAnonymousCrmId !== 'null' && localStorageAnonymousCrmId !== 'undefined'){
                        crmId = localStorageAnonymousCrmId;
                    } else if(!!cookieAnonymousCrmId && cookieAnonymousCrmId !== 'null' && cookieAnonymousCrmId !== 'undefined'){
                        crmId = cookieAnonymousCrmId;
                    } else{
                        try{
                            crmId = crypto.randomUUID();
                            setCookie("anonymousCrmId", crmId, 18000);
                            localStorage.setItem('anonymousCrmId', crmId);
                        }catch (e) {
                            console.log("Error generating UUID for crmId");
                        }
                    }
                }else{
                    crmId = appInit.crmId;
                }
                if(!crmId || crmId === 'null' || crmId === 'undefined'){
                    function getRandomCrmId(){
                        var random = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100000);
                        for(var i=0; i< 4; i++){
                            random += "-" + Math.floor(Math.random() * 100000);
                        }
                        return random;
                    }
                    crmId = getRandomCrmId();
                }
                return crmId + '-' + Date.now();
            }
        </script>

                        found = true;
                        newEntries.push([strName, strValue]);
                    }
                    // Skip duplicates
                } else {
                    newEntries.push(entry);
                }
            }

            if (!found) {
                newEntries.push([strName, strValue]);
            }

            this._entries = newEntries;
        };

        SafeURLSearchParams.prototype.sort = function() {
            this._entries.sort(function(a, b) {
                return a[0].localeCompare(b[0]);
            });
        };

        SafeURLSearchParams.prototype.toString = function() {
            var parts = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < this._entries.length; i++) {
                parts.push(this._encode(this._entries[i][0]) + '=' + this._encode(this._entries[i][1]));
            }
            return parts.join('&');
        };

        SafeURLSearchParams.prototype.forEach = function(callback, thisArg) {
            for (var i = 0; i < this._entries.length; i++) {
                callback.call(thisArg, this._entries[i][1], this._entries[i][0], this);
            }
        };

        SafeURLSearchParams.prototype.toObject = function() {
            var result = {};
            for (var i = 0; i < this._entries.length; i++) {
                var key = this._entries[i][0];
                if (!(key in result)) {
                    result[key] = this._entries[i][1];
                }
            }
            return result;
        };

        SafeURLSearchParams.prototype.toObjectAll = function() {
            var result = {};
            for (var i = 0; i < this._entries.length; i++) {
                var key = this._entries[i][0];
                if (!(key in result)) {
                    result[key] = [];
                }
                result[key].push(this._entries[i][1]);
            }
            return result;
        };

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
            if(window.userInteractionCaptured) return;
            var interactionEvents = ["touchstart", "touchmove", "scroll", "mousemove", "mousedown", "DOMMouseScroll", "mousewheel", "keyup"];
            window.userInteractionCaptured = false;
            function interactionHandler() {
                if (window.userInteractionCaptured) return;
                console.debug('User Interaction captured');
                window.userInteractionCaptured = true;
                interactionEvents.forEach(function(eventType) {
                    document.body.removeEventListener(eventType, interactionHandler);
                });
            }
            interactionEvents.forEach(function(eventType) {
                document.body.addEventListener(eventType, interactionHandler);

        })

        function getMetaInfoFromPath(titleDescMap, value){
            try{
                var path = window.location.pathname;
                if (path.startsWith('/')) {
                    path = path.substring(1);
                }
                var languagePaths = ['fr-ca/', 'es/', 'ru/', 'pl/', 'ar/'];
                for (var langPath of languagePaths) {
                    if (path.toLowerCase().startsWith(langPath)) {
                        path = path.substring(langPath.length);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                var pathNames= [path.replace(/\//g, '-'), path.split("/")[0]];
                for(var pathName of pathNames){
                    var key = pathName+"."+value;
                    if(titleDescMap.hasOwnProperty(key)){
                        return titleDescMap[key];
                    }
                }
            }catch (e) {
                return '';
            }
        }

    <script>
        var isAnonymous = appInit.isAnonymous;
        function getCookieByName(cookieName) {
            var name = cookieName + "=";
            var cookieDecoded = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie);
            var cookieArr = cookieDecoded.split('; ');
            var res = null;
            cookieArr.forEach(function (val) {
                if (val.indexOf(name) === 0) res = val.substring(name.length);
            });
            return res;
        }

        function updateUserCategoryCookie(cookieValue) {
            // Expire the userCategory cookie in 50 years
            document.cookie = "userCategory=" + cookieValue + ";max-age="+ 60*60*24*365*50+"; path=/";
        }

        /*
        *  LIM: Logged-in Member
        *  LOM: Logged-out Member
        *  PU:  Public User
        *  RPU: Recurring Public User
        * */

        var userCategory = getCookieByName("userCategory");
        if(!userCategory){
            updateUserCategoryCookie("PU");
        }else if(isAnonymous){
            if(userCategory == "LIM"){
                updateUserCategoryCookie("LOM");
            }else if(userCategory != "LOM"){
                updateUserCategoryCookie("RPU");
            }
        }

                var expires = '';
                if (days) {
                    var date = new Date();
                    date.setTime(date.getTime() + (days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
                    expires = '; expires=' + date.toUTCString();

                document.cookie = name + '=' + (value || '') + expires + '; path=/';
